== Summary ==
Slip “•Garindan, Imperial Spy” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 336, 581, 1059)). Version [[Garindan, Imperial Spy|Garindan, Imperial Spy (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
